label: Accordion gallery
desc: A row of image panels where one is open and the rest collapse to slim strips; click, hover or arrow keys switch, and it stacks vertically in narrow containers.
use: Portfolio or destination showcases (fills its parent; give the parent a height).

label: Animated list
desc: A feed whose rows rise in one by one, slide in when added and fold away when dismissed, with arrow-key navigation and Delete to dismiss.
use: Activity feeds, notifications and inboxes (scrolls inside its parent).

label: Border glow
desc: A surface with a glowing edge that follows the pointer and leaks a soft halo; a slow light circles the border when idle, and focus lights it up.
use: Wrap pricing cards, feature tiles or call-out panels.

label: Bounce cards
desc: A fan of cards that bounces into place on scroll; hover or focus lifts one and nudges the others, click gives a hop and reports the choice.
use: Hero visuals, gallery teasers and "pick a card" selectors.

label: Card swap
desc: A stacked card deck where the front card drops away and returns to the back; buttons, dots, arrow keys and a pausable autoplay switch cards.
use: Feature walkthroughs and step previews beside hero copy.

label: Chroma grid
desc: A grid of tinted link/button cards where a pointer or focus spotlight keeps colour while the rest of the grid greys out.
use: Team pages, partner grids and directory listings.

label: Decay card
desc: A card whose picture frays away like old paper under hover or focus, with a button to let it crumble fully and restore it; an SVG-filter effect.
use: Editorial, archive or story cards with an artwork area.

label: Folder
desc: A drawn folder that opens to fan out the papers inside; click, Enter or Space toggles, hover peeks, and paper content is real DOM.
use: File collections, resource bundles and download groups.

label: Pixel card
desc: A card covered by tiny squares that bloom outward from the pointer or focus point and shimmer, then fold away; drawn on canvas.
use: Feature cards and call-outs that should wake on interaction.

label: Profile card
desc: A person card with banner, generated avatar, status dot, bio, stats and Follow / Message actions, plus a pointer-driven foil sheen; adapts to its container width.
use: Team, author and community member pages.

label: Reflective card
desc: A glass card on a glossy floor with a faded mirrored reflection and a highlight that follows the pointer (drifts on its own otherwise).
use: Product, ticket or pass showcases on a plain backdrop.
